citation: State of Punjab v. Gurpreet Singh (2020) 7 SCC 456
reasoning_summary: IPC 304 (culpable homicide not amounting to murder) applied as mens rea for murder was not established. Death occurred during sudden fight without premeditation. Medical evidence showed single blow causing death.

facts_established.actus_reus: Accused caused fatal injury during altercation
facts_established.mens_rea: Sudden fight, no premeditation or intention to kill
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Weapon recovered, accused present at scene
